name: AI Tinkerers London
notes: 19 events in past 12 months; part of a 253-city network. Runs both evening formats (UK's Shortest Hackathon, 17:30 start) and weekends (Consumer AI Hackathon 9-10 Nov with ElevenLabs/a16z). Host: Louis Knight-Webb.

name: The Hack Collective
notes: Curates/aggregates London hackathons for university students rather than running its own. Useful as a distribution channel, not a venue booker.

name: notanother.pizza
notes: Listed among active London organisers; ran AI Healthcare Hackathon with Anima x OpenAI. Cadence and attendance unverified.

name: Encode London
notes: Dual-track: hackathon plus conference. Has its own venue (Encode Hub), so less likely to need third-party space.

name: enki events
notes: Named as a London organiser; no primary URL or attendance confirmed. Needs follow-up before use.

name: KCL Tech (HackKings)
notes: 300+ builders, free 24-hour event, 21-22 Nov 2026. Uses university space, so a venue prospect only if it outgrows Bush House.

name: Major League Hacking (MLH)
notes: 2026 season Jul 2025 - Jun 2026, 200+ student hackathons worldwide, Europe/UK filter available. Member Events get an on-site MLH coach. Individual UK events source their own venues - the highest-volume lead source here.

name: Startup Weekend (Techstars)
notes: Canonical 54-hour Friday-evening-to-Sunday format - the single best fit for a venue that is idle from Friday 18:00 through the weekend.
